integrity: Proof by base-\(b\) carrying is included; the finite verifier is independent of the proof counting and requires only Python standard library. No independent validation or publication certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts indexed multiplicity vectors for geometric exponent sets only at moduli divisible by the next-to-highest power of the base. It neither determines global minimum moduli nor covers the binary base. Direct finite enumeration is supporting evidence and does not prove the universal statement. Literature comparisons leave a risk of equivalent unindexed work and inaccessible relevant companion full text.
title: Exact target-collision counts for geometric exponent sets at two-digit moduli
